section: Microsoft Teams smart workplace ebook: feature groups across Teams Rooms, Teams Phone, Teams Premium and Copilot
body:
An AVI-SPL interactive ebook on the Microsoft Teams smart workplace groups Microsoft's meeting and workplace features into themes. It is a quick map of what the Microsoft platform offers, with an important condition on availability.

**Framing**
Microsoft Teams Rooms is presented as delivering value across the whole meeting and workplace lifecycle, through the themes Boost Productivity with Intelligent Spaces, Collaborate with Impact and Optimize Workspaces. The ebook ties the workplace to the integration of Teams Phone, Teams Rooms, Teams Premium and Copilot.

**Availability condition (as stated)**
The ebook states that the listed features have to be enabled by the organization. Their availability may depend on Teams Premium and Copilot licenses, and also on meeting type, tenant configuration, supported languages, rollout status and region. Before enabling any of these capabilities, organizations are advised to evaluate privacy, consent, enrollment, regional requirements and administrative controls.

**Boost Productivity with Intelligent Spaces**
Feature tabs: Your Personal AI Assistant, Intelligent Recap, Multi-Lingual Support. Detail is given for the personal AI assistant:
- Catch up on discussions without scrolling.
- Draft or refine messages.
- Generate ideas for projects and meetings.

**Collaborate with Impact**
Feature tabs: Smart Calling And Meetings, Events App, Advanced Call Queue Handling, AI-powered Presence, Virtual Appointments. Detail is given for smart calling and meetings:
- Start a call from contact cards, chat or the calls tab.
- Receive real-time insights on follow-up questions and suggested next steps.
- Transfer a call to a colleague with the full context of the earlier discussion.

**Optimize Workspaces**
Feature tabs: Mobile Experience, Microsoft Places, Hybrid Room Experience, Voice Isolation. Detail is given for the mobile experience:
- Transfer calls and meetings from mobile to desktop or back with no interruption to the conversation.
- Use a shared device to make and receive calls or join meetings.
- Consistent experiences across a wide range of certified devices.

**Advance Protection**
Feature tabs: Secure Information, Reduce Vishing Attacks, AI-powered Management. Detail is given for secure information:
- Apply the right sensitivity labels, and restrict who can record.
- Turn on customized watermarking for content and for attendee video.
- Use meeting templates to apply policies automatically.
- Use end-to-end encryption (E2EE) on calls and meetings.

**When to use this**
Use when a customer asks what the Microsoft Teams platform offers beyond basic meetings, or whether a named feature needs to be enabled or licensed.

**Not stated in this source**
The captured content gives no detail for the other feature tabs, does not say which licence each feature requires, and gives no prices.
